name: Copenhagen International Improv Festival 2021 | #ciif21
description:
We are excited for ✨CIIF21✨ which will take place from Monday 18th October to Sunday 24th October 2021!

Copenhagen International Improv Festival 2021 offers outstanding Improv workshops, premium shows, jams, performance opportunities, and epic after parties. CIIF21 is for anybody who loves improv - beginner to advanced.

👉 www.CIIF.eu 👈
Is where you find all the festival info.

Please help other improv-lovers become aware of the festival by inviting them to this event. Huge thank you for this!

We can't wait to welcome you back or meet you for the first time 🙌

PS: All the most important CIIF info is shared with those on our email lists before we post on Facebook. So don’t miss out - go register your email at www.ciif.eu and you will be the first in the know!

name: CIIF21 Premium Show Thursday 21/10  at Det Ny Teater
description:
Come see the funniest English comedy shows happening in Copenhagen this autumn at Copenhagen International Improv Festival. Det Ny Teater is a perfect venue for comedy and you are guaranteed to have a good time when our world class comedy improvisers takes the stage.

Get your ticket here: https://www.improvcomedy.eu/event/ciif21-premium-show-monday-18-october-2/

During this CIIF21 Premium show there will be performances by:

ICC Short Form (Denmark)
ICC Short form will bring you fast-paced improv comedy that you will absolutely love. These guys know what they are doing and are bringing the heat, hotter than hell!

ICC – Doctor’s Orders (Denmark)
Get healthy through laughter. You’ve been prescribed a show full of surprises — every show is as different as it is memorable. Check these performers out because these are your Doctor’s Orders.

CIIF All-Stars (USA & Canada) 
The CIIF All-start show cast is comprised of some of the most brilliant professional North American improvisers ever to step foot on European soil! The cast has 100 years+ of improv experience among them. Their Bios are some of the most impressive back home. If you want to see absolute top-shelf improv this is the show you can’t miss!

Stranger Things Have Happened (NL)

Stranger Things Have Happened is proud to bring to Copenhagen their classic brand of razor fast, whip smart short form improv comedy. Incorporating musical numbers, murder, mildly irritating relatives, searches for love, communing with the occult and of course our beloved rubber duck, you never know what you will get at a Stranger Things Have Happened show! So get your weirdest and most wonderful
suggestions ready, and join us on an adventure into the unexpected.

ICC – Murder of Crows (DK) 

Everybody cheats and lies, in this dark and dingy world inspired by the film genre from the 1920’s and 40’s. No one can be trusted, or can they? All MURDER OF CROWS shows are uniquely different as you the audience provide the title which inspires the show. Past shows include “The Mystery of the Wet Chandelier,” “Sink the Blue Turtle” and “The Worst of the Two Deadly Sins.

name: CIIF’21 Premium  Show Friday 22/10 at Det Ny Teater
description:
Come see the funniest English comedy shows happening in Copenhagen this autumn at Copenhagen International Improv Festival. Det Ny Teater is a perfect venue for comedy and you are guaranteed to have a good time when our world class comedy improvisers takes the stage.

Get your ticket here: https://www.improvcomedy.eu/event/ciif21-premium-show-thursday-21-october-2/

During this CIIF21 Premium show there will be performances by:

Free Foxes (NO)
A two-person improvised show that plays with humor, tension and dynamics – exploring the light and dark between us. Kristīne Slotina and Kevin Gow conjure suspenseful characters and scenarios out of thin air. Experience stories discovered before your very eyes.

ICC – Improv Made You a Mixtape (DK)
Rewind to your dearest, weirdest, most fabulous music memory and loop us in on why a certain song or album is so special to you.As the Rockstar that you are, expect to be interviewed about your song or album choice. We will take anything and everything:

From songs you dance to with your sweetheart to the track you lost your virginity to. From that one album that gets you to do the extra burpee to a breakup anthem.From your current on-repeat tune to that thing you play when you miss home. The possibilities are endless! Next, sit back and watch us untangle the lyrics, vibe, and sound of your treasured tunes as we press play on an entirely improvised show based on your song or album suggestion. Frequencies are expected to range from AM(azing) to FM (fu&#ing memorable, duh). Fast forward to after the show, when your cheeks hurt from laughing and all of your song suggestions are bundled up into a mixtape, we made for you.
